profile.headline: Improving Process, Workflows, and Life
profile.summary:
"A significantly advanced systems engineer is indistinguishable from an application developer." -Adam Jacob

I develop tools and services ranging from managing large-scale distributed infrastructure to improving the developer experience (DX) to reduce time to value. I am lazy; I <3 automation.

I am passionate about open-source development and its ability to empower others. I am active in the tech community, i.e., user group and conference organizer and presenter. My preferred toolchain includes GNU Linux, Python, and git.

I am well versed in cloud and platform services like AWS and GitHub.

Thanks to the pandemic, I now enjoy the digital nomad lifestyle.

CI, continuous improvement of myself and the world around me.
